recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Core should continue to use Observation.interpretationContext for current builds while the Extension Pack retains observation-precondition for R5 and earlier; no FHIR-core follow-up is required for FHIR-17228.
issue_request: FHIR-17228 was a Published STU3 FHIR-core Observation change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It requested support for contextual information needed to interpret an Observation and the final disposition selected an Observation-scoped 0..* precondition extension with Reference(Observation), plus follow-up Observation notes guidance.
initial_application: Historical commit 4b3545da2a5d added the observation-precondition extension row to source/observation/observation-extensions-spreadsheet.xml with Observation context, Reference(Observation) value, and the requested short/definition. Follow-up issue FHIR-17578 was applied in commit 1c6e2d841cd2 by adding Observation notes guidance about codes, components, and the precondition extension.
additional_context: The core checkout no longer owns the observation-precondition extension source; the Extension Pack contains the current definition. FHIR-38971 later clarified the extension wording and that it was not a modifier extension. FHIR-42899 made observation-precondition version-specific through R5 and directed post-R5 use toward Observation.interpretationContext. FHIR-51529 then added Observation.interpretationContext to current core Observation, and the current Observation notes point critical non-grouping context to that element.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding the old extension to core would be wrong because the extension moved to the Extension Pack, and current core already has the build-scope element and notes guidance that cover the approved supporting-context semantics.
